quests.conceptTitle: Punctuation Conductor: Meaning-Changing vs. Tone-Changing Punctuation (.)

quests.nativeTip: Since the speaker has more than one sister, this clause is essential to identify which sister is meant - leaving out the commas actually changes the meaning.
quests.visualAnchor: 🖋️ Raw: My sister who lives in Portland is a talented artist my other sister lives nearby ➔ Final: My sister who lives in Portland is a talented artist. My other sister lives nearby.
